author: Theo
body: I'd been looking for a trustworthy dog groomer in the Wakefield area for a while, so glad I found Keith's K9 Care. Took my black Labrador Bella in and Keith was calm, professional and clearly knows what he's doing. Bella usually really doesn't like bath time or even her paws being touched but she was completely at ease with Keith, which says a lot. She came back looking and smelling great too. If you're after a dog groomer in Hall Green or around the Barnsley area, well worth a call.
